content:
Priya: Heads up — customer's security team just sent a CAIQ for our POC. They want a clear delegation map for KMS, logs, model weights residency, and data retention. PDF here: https://files.example.com/caiq-ACME.pdf
Owen: I can take point on this. Quick Q — are we doing Hosted API for the POC or Dedicated?
Priya: Hosted for now, might flip to Dedicated if they sign. They specifically asked: who controls KMS, do we persist plaintext prompts, can logs contain PII, and is BYOK available on Hosted?
Leah: Short answers: Hosted = Redwood-managed keys (cloud KMS); we do not persist plaintext beyond request processing; logs are metadata + redacted request/response by default. Dedicated/Private = KMS integration / BYOK and log-forwarding possible. I'll draft the CAIQ delegation rows.
Jae: Add: model weights are ours on Hosted (customers don't upload models there). For Private they can run their own weights. Also adding SOC2 / GDPR pointer for the questionnaire.
security-bot: Uploaded template CSV: https://files.example.com/templates/caiq-delegation-template.csv :white_check_mark:
Priya: Legal pushed back asking if BYOK is strictly unsupported on Hosted or if there's a workaround for POC. Can someone confirm official policy so I can respond?
Owen: Confirmed with legal earlier — BYOK is not available for Hosted. We can offer Dedicated with a contractual KMS integration (lead time ~2-4 weeks) or Private for on-prem/HSM.
Leah: Draft of the matrix snippet I'm going to drop into the CSV:
```
Control,KMS ownership,Hosted,Dedicated,Private
KMS,Owner,Redwood-managed cloud KMS,Configurable (customer KMS via contract),Customer-managed KMS/HSM
Data persistence,Plaintext storage,No persistent plaintext (transient in-process only),Configurable retention policies,Customer controls data residency/on-prem
Logging,Access to raw request data,Redacted by default; metadata logs retained,Optional log-forwarding per contract,Full customer log control
Model weights,Who provides weights,Redwood-hosted (no customer upload),Customer can deploy specified weights,Customer-managed
```
Leah: I'll finish the rest of CAIQ rows and upload CSV by EOD. Owen — can you add the Dedicated lead time estimate and cost delta to the doc? 
Owen: Yep, I'll add lead time + estimated delta. 
Priya: Perfect. I'll reply to the customer with the CSV and cc legal. Tagging @Owen @Leah. :thumbsup:
Leah: Uploaded completed CSV here: https://files.example.com/outputs/acme-caiq-delegation-2026-03-21.csv
Priya: Thanks all — closing once customer ack received.
